alert.ai_ledger_unrecorded_body.source: This run's AI spend was not added to its tenant's month, so the month's total is short by it; the run's own summary keeps the amount as ai_spend. {$error}

digest.source_dialog_kept.text: 已保留：它的信會繼續收進你的摘要。不收就不再收它的信。
digest.source_dialog_kept.source: Kept: its issues go on into your digest. Stop it to take no more of its mail.

digest.source_dialog_stopped.text: 已停收：不再收它的信。停收期間寄到的信會被刪除，恢復後也不會回來。
digest.source_dialog_stopped.source: Stopped: its mail is no longer taken. Mail that arrives while it is stopped is deleted, and restoring it does not bring that mail back.

digest.source_review_refused.text: 這個決定沒有送出（HTTP {$status}）。請再試一次。
digest.source_review_refused.source: The decision did not go through (HTTP {$status}). Try again.

digest.source_review_signed_out.text: 登入已過期，所以這個決定沒有存下。請重新整理頁面並再次登入。

legal.contact_privacy.text: 隱私權與個人資料請求

legal.prevails.text: 本文件以繁體中文版為正式版本，英文版為譯文；兩者內容有出入時，以中文版為準。
legal.prevails.source: The Traditional Chinese text is the authoritative version. The English text is a translation; where the two differ, the Chinese text prevails.

privacy.changes.text: 本政策如有變更，我們會在本頁公布新版本並更新日期。變更若影響您的權利，或影響我們蒐集、處理或利用您資料的方式（包含蒐集的資料與收到資料的對象），我們也會在生效至少 {$days} 天前，寄信到您登入用的電子郵件地址通知您。
privacy.changes.source: If this policy changes, we post the new version on this page with a new date. If a change affects your rights, or how we collect, process or use your data, including what we collect and who receives it, we also write to the address you sign in with at least {$days} days before it takes effect.

privacy.cookies.text: 您登入時，本服務會設定一個 Cookie：{$cookie}。它讓您在 {$days} 天內或登出前保持登入，且只有本網站能讀取。本服務不設定其他 Cookie，也不使用分析、廣告或追蹤工具。精選摘要頁面會連線到的其他網站，列在「還有誰會收到」。
privacy.cookies.source: When you sign in, the service sets one cookie, {$cookie}. It keeps you signed in for {$days} days or until you sign out, and only this site can read it. The service sets no other cookie and uses no analytics, advertising or tracking tools. The other sites a digest page contacts are listed under “Who else receives it”.

privacy.deletion.text: 您寄信要求刪除資料時，我們會在收到請求後 {$days} 天內完成：把您的地址從受邀名單移除，這會結束您的登入工作階段並刪除您的登入紀錄，並由我們手動刪除您精選摘要資料庫裡的資料。刪除之後仍會留下：每日備份，保留到到期為止（見「保存期間」）；Cloudflare 的日誌，保留到它自己的期限屆滿；Anthropic 為撰寫摘要而收到的內容，依 Anthropic 自己的條款處理；營運者 Discord 頻道裡的執行失敗警示；以及登記庫裡以精選摘要代號記錄的執行紀錄、AI 費用與排程，這些會保留作為服務的營運紀錄，其中不含您的電子郵件地址。我們提供給您的複本，是您精選摘要資料庫的匯出檔，格式與每日備份相同。若您在候補名單中並以登記的電子郵件地址寄信要求刪除，我們也會在 {$days} 天內將該筆登記從登記庫移除；每日備份中的複本則依相同期限到期。
privacy.deletion.source: When you write to ask us to delete your data, we finish within {$days} days of your request: we take your address off the invite list, which ends your sessions and deletes your sign-in records, and we delete the data in your digest's database by hand. After that, these remain: the daily backups, until they expire (see “How long we keep it”); Cloudflare's logs, until their own period ends; what Anthropic received to write the summaries, which Anthropic's own terms govern; the alerts of failed runs in the operator's Discord channel; and the run records, AI spend and schedule the registry holds under your digest's id, which we keep as the service's operating record and which do not hold your email address. A copy we send you is an export of your digest's database, in the format the daily backup uses. If you are on the waitlist and write from that address to ask us to delete your entry, we remove it from the registry within {$days} days; its copies in the daily backups expire on the same schedule.

privacy.description.text: Cyris 託管測試版保存哪些讀者資料、存放在哪裡，以及還有誰會收到。
privacy.description.source: What the Cyris hosted beta keeps about its readers, where it is kept, and who else receives it.

privacy.intro.text: Cyris 依讀者選定的訂閱來源與電子報製作精選摘要。本託管服務是免費、僅限受邀者使用的封閉測試版，由一位以「Cyris」名義營運的個人提供（以下稱「我們」）。本政策說明本服務保存哪些關於您的資料、存放在哪裡、還有誰會收到，以及如何向我們詢問。我們依中華民國（臺灣）《個人資料保護法》處理您的個人資料。
privacy.intro.source: Cyris makes a digest of the feeds and newsletters its readers choose. This hosted service is a free, invite-only closed beta, run by an individual under the name Cyris (“we”). This policy says what the service keeps about you, where it is kept, who else receives it, and how to ask us about it. We handle your personal data under the Personal Data Protection Act of the Republic of China (Taiwan).

privacy.kept_account.text: 您的電子郵件地址、該地址可以登入的精選摘要，以及您受邀的時間。
privacy.kept_account.source: Your email address, the digest it may sign in to, and when you were invited.

privacy.kept_digest.text: 您的精選摘要：其來源（訂閱網址與電子報寄件者）、設定、從這些來源抓取的文章及其內文、據此製作的各期摘要與頁面，以及您對其文章所投的票。每份精選摘要只有一位讀者。
privacy.kept_digest.source: Your digest: its sources (feed addresses and newsletter senders), its settings, the articles fetched from those sources with their text, the issues made from them and their pages, and the votes you cast on its articles. Each digest has one reader.

privacy.kept_logs.text: 日誌：Cloudflare 會記錄每個對本服務的請求，以及每次執行的輸出（Workers Logs），其中可能包含請求的時間、網址與您的 IP 位址等連線資訊。Cloudflare 保存這些日誌最長 {$days} 天。本服務自己寫入的日誌以精選摘要的代號識別，設計上不寫入您的電子郵件地址與登入權杖。
privacy.kept_logs.source: Logs: Cloudflare keeps a log of each request to the service and of each run's output (Workers Logs). It can include connection details such as the time and address of a request and your IP address. Cloudflare keeps these logs for up to {$days} days. The lines the service writes itself name your digest by its id, and are designed to hold neither your email address nor a sign-in token.

privacy.kept_newsletters.text: 寄到您精選摘要專屬隨機地址的電子報：寄件者、主旨、日期、內文與部分郵件標頭。電子報可能含有寄件者放入的任何內容，例如您的姓名。您的精選摘要下一次執行時，會把符合其來源的郵件轉成文章並刪除該郵件；不符合任何來源的郵件在 {$days} 天後刪除。
privacy.kept_newsletters.source: Newsletter mail sent to your digest's own random address: its sender, subject, date, body and some of its headers. A newsletter can hold anything its sender put in it, such as your name. Your digest's next run turns each message one of its sources matches into an article and deletes the message; a message no source matches is deleted after {$days} days.

privacy.kept_sign_in.text: 您的登入紀錄：每個登入連結與每個登入工作階段，以其權杖的雜湊值保存，不保存權杖本身，並附上您的電子郵件地址與到期時間。連結在 {$minutes} 分鐘後失效，工作階段在 {$days} 天後失效。您在登入頁要求的每個連結，也會連同您的地址與時間記錄下來；這筆紀錄滿一天後，會在下一次有人要求登入連結時清除。
privacy.kept_sign_in.source: Your sign-ins: each sign-in link and each session, stored as a hash of its token, not the token itself, with your email address and when it expires. A link expires after {$minutes} minutes and a session after {$days} days. Each link you ask for on the sign-in page is also recorded with your address and the time; once that record is a day old, it is cleared the next time anyone asks for a sign-in link.

privacy.kept_spend.text: 您的精選摘要使用 AI 的費用：每次執行所用的模型、token 用量與費用，以及每月的總額。另有每次執行的紀錄：何時排入佇列、何時開始與結束，以及結束的方式。
privacy.kept_spend.source: What your digest's AI use cost: for each run, the model, the tokens it used and their cost, and for each month, the total. And a record of each run: when it was queued, started and ended, and how it ended.

privacy.kept_waitlist.text: 候補名單登記：若您在 Cyris 網站加入託管版候補名單，我們會保存您的電子郵件地址、您選填的備註、送出時的頁面語言與登記時間。為防止濫用，我們也會保存您 IP 位址的 SHA-256 雜湊值與請求時間，滿一天後於下一次登記時清除。
privacy.kept_waitlist.source: Waitlist signups: if you join the waitlist on the Cyris website, your email address, any optional note you write, the page language you submitted in, and when you signed up. To limit abuse, a SHA-256 hash of your IP address and the time of your request are kept for one day and cleared on the next submission.

privacy.operator.text: 營運者的工具可以讀取與修改任何精選摘要的資料。我們只會為了回覆支援請求、調查事故或失敗的執行、處理濫用行為，或依法律要求，才對您的精選摘要使用這些工具。這些工具目前還不會記錄每一次的使用。營運者也會看到每份精選摘要的例行報告：其來源、執行紀錄、AI 費用，以及等待處理的每封電子報的寄件者與主旨，但不含內文。
privacy.operator.source: The operator's tools can read and change any digest's data. We use them on your digest only to answer a support request, to look into an incident or a failed run, to deal with abuse, or when the law requires it. Those tools do not yet keep a record of each time they are used. The operator also sees a routine report of every digest: its sources, its runs, its AI spend, and the sender and subject of each newsletter waiting in it, but not their bodies.

privacy.operator_heading.text: 我們何時會查看您的資料
privacy.operator_heading.source: When we look at your data

privacy.recipient_anthropic.text: Anthropic 負責撰寫摘要。每次執行會把精選摘要中文章與電子報的內文，連同精選摘要的指示（例如風格與輸出語言），送到 Anthropic 的 API，由模型 {$model} 處理。
privacy.recipient_anthropic.source: Anthropic writes the summaries. Each run sends the text of the articles and newsletters in your digest, with your digest's instructions such as its style and output language, to Anthropic's API, to the model {$model}.

privacy.recipient_browser.text: 精選摘要頁面會從 Google Fonts 載入字型，並從刊登文章的網站載入文章圖片，因此您開啟頁面時，瀏覽器會連線到這些網站。登入頁、本頁與設定頁不從任何其他網站載入內容。
privacy.recipient_browser.source: A digest page loads its fonts from Google Fonts and each article's picture from the site that published it, so your browser contacts those sites when you open the page. The sign-in pages, this page and the settings page load nothing from any other site.

privacy.recipient_cloudflare.text: Cloudflare 代管本服務並儲存上述資料，也負責寄出登入信、接收寄到您精選摘要地址的電子報，並在候補名單表單上執行 Turnstile 以阻擋自動化送出。
privacy.recipient_cloudflare.source: Cloudflare hosts the service and stores the data above. It also sends the sign-in mail, receives the newsletter mail sent to your digest's address, and runs Turnstile on the waitlist form to block automated submissions.

privacy.recipient_discord.text: 執行失敗時，會有一則載明精選摘要代號與錯誤內容的警示，送到營運者在 Discord 上的頻道。
privacy.recipient_discord.source: When a run fails, an alert naming your digest's id and the error goes to the operator's channel on Discord.

privacy.required.text: 您可以自由決定是否提供資料。電子郵件地址是登入所必需的，不提供就無法使用本服務；來源與設定由您自行決定，沒有來源就不會產生精選摘要。
privacy.required.source: You are free to decide whether to give us your data. Your email address is needed to sign in, so without it you cannot use the service. Sources and settings are yours to choose; with no sources, no digest is made.

privacy.retention.text: 您精選摘要的資料在您使用本服務期間保存。您要求刪除（見「您的權利」）或我們終止您的使用權限時，我們會在其後 {$deletion} 天內刪除。您連續 {$months} 個月沒有登入時，我們也會刪除：屆滿前 {$reminder} 天，我們會寄信到您登入用的電子郵件地址提醒您，您只要登入一次就重新計算。本服務目前還不記錄您最後一次登入的日期；這項紀錄啟用後，這 {$months} 個月自啟用日或您之後最近一次登入起算，啟用時我們會依本政策的變更方式通知您。本測試版若要結束，我們會依服務條款在至少 {$end} 天前通知您。本服務每天把每份精選摘要的資料庫與登記庫匯出到 Cloudflare R2 儲存空間作為備份，每份匯出檔設定為上傳 {$days} 天後到期，Cloudflare 通常在到期後 {$hours} 小時內移除。因此我們刪除的資料，最多還會在備份中保留約 {$most} 天。
privacy.retention.source: Your digest's data is kept while you use the service. We delete it within {$deletion} days after you ask us to (see “Your rights”) or after we end your access. We also delete it once you have gone {$months} months without signing in: {$reminder} days before that, we write to the address you sign in with to remind you, and signing in once starts the count again. The service does not yet record the date you last signed in; once it does, the {$months} months run from that day or from your latest sign-in after it, and we will tell you when it starts, in the way this policy's changes are announced. If the beta is to end, we tell you at least {$end} days before, as the terms say. Every day the service exports each digest's database, and the registry, to Cloudflare R2 storage as a backup. Each export is set to expire {$days} days after it is uploaded, and Cloudflare usually removes it within {$hours} hours of that. So data we have deleted can stay in the backups for up to about {$most} days.

privacy.rights.text: 依《個人資料保護法》，您可以請求查詢或閱覽您的資料、請求製給複製本、請求補充或更正、請求停止蒐集、處理或利用，或請求刪除。目前還沒有可自行處理的頁面：請以您登入用的電子郵件地址寄信至 {$privacy}。查詢、閱覽或製給複製本的請求，我們會在 {$see} 天內答覆；補充、更正或停止蒐集、處理或利用的請求，會在 {$change} 天內答覆。需要延長時，我們會寄信說明原因，延長分別不超過 {$see} 天與 {$change} 天。刪除的請求，我們會依下段說明在 {$deletion} 天內完成。
privacy.rights.source: Under the Personal Data Protection Act you may ask to see your data or have a copy of it, to have it completed or corrected, to have us stop collecting, processing or using it, or to have it deleted. There is no page for this yet: write to {$privacy} from the address you sign in with. We answer a request to see your data or have a copy of it within {$see} days, and a request to complete, correct or stop within {$change} days. If we need longer, we will write to tell you why, and the extension is at most {$see} and {$change} more days. A request to delete is done within {$deletion} days, as below.

onboarding.cards_empty.text: 這 {$count} 個資訊來源沒有抓到文章：{$names}。它們仍保留在來源中，第一期會再讀取一次；請到「設定」的「來源」檢查。

onboarding.cards_failed.text: {$reason} 請按「略過」不投票直接繼續，或重新載入頁面再試一次。
onboarding.cards_failed.source: {$reason} Press Skip to go on without votes, or reload the page to try again.

onboarding.cards_no_sources.text: 尚無可抽取文章的資訊來源。請按「上一步」挑選，或按「下一步」繼續。
onboarding.cards_no_sources.source: There are no feeds to draw from yet. Press Back to pick some, or Next to go on.

onboarding.cards_none.text: 目前沒有可投票的文章。沒有投票也能產生第一期，請按「下一步」繼續。
onboarding.cards_none.source: There is no article to vote on yet. Press Next to go on: the first issue works without votes.

onboarding.cards_poll_failed.text: 剛才無法抓取資訊來源（{$reason}），這些卡片只來自之前抓到的文章。
onboarding.cards_poll_failed.source: The feeds could not be fetched just now ({$reason}), so these cards are only what had been fetched before.

onboarding.discord_webhook_help.text: 請貼上完整網址，Discord 確認網址存在後才會儲存。
onboarding.discord_webhook_help.source: Paste the whole URL; it is saved once Discord confirms it exists.

onboarding.email_to_needed.source: Enter the address the digest is sent to, too.

onboarding.feeds_load_failed.text: 無法載入資訊來源清單：{$reason}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
onboarding.feeds_load_failed.source: Could not load the feed list: {$reason}. Reload the page to try again.

onboarding.fetching_cards.text: 正在從資訊來源抓取最新文章，可能需要一兩分鐘…
onboarding.fetching_cards.source: Fetching the latest articles from your feeds. This can take a minute or two…

onboarding.first_issue_lede.text: 現在就用你的資訊來源和投票產生一期精選，不必等到下一個發布時間。產生方式和排定的精選相同，也會發送通知；按「略過」則讓第一期在那個時間產生。
onboarding.first_issue_lede.source: Build an issue now from your feeds and votes, instead of waiting for the next publish hour. It runs as a scheduled issue does, notifications included, and Skip leaves the first issue to that hour.

onboarding.gone.text: 已不在資訊來源中 · 未記錄
onboarding.gone.source: No longer in the feed · not recorded

onboarding.hours_help.text: 填入 0 到 23 的整點，以上一步的時區為準；不接受半點。
onboarding.hours_help.source: Whole hours from 0 to 23, in the timezone of the step before; half hours are refused.

onboarding.intro.text: 每一步都可以略過，略過的步驟會保留目前的值；這裡的所有設定之後都能在「設定」修改。
onboarding.intro.source: Skip any step: it keeps its current value, and everything here can be changed later in Settings.

onboarding.issue_built.text: 第一期已產生。本站不發布線上版，第一期只會透過通知送達。
onboarding.issue_built.source: Your first issue is built. This deployment publishes no site, so it reached you only through its notifications.

onboarding.issue_published.text: 第一期已發布。{#read}閱讀本期{/read}，或到{#archive}過往精選{/archive}查看它和之後的每一期。
onboarding.issue_published.source: Your first issue is published. {#read}Read it{/read}, or find it with every later issue in the {#archive}archive{/archive}.

onboarding.kept.text: 已勾選，但不在所選主題

onboarding.model_hint_check.text: 按「下一步」會先實際呼叫供應商一次，打錯字會直接在這裡擋下。
onboarding.model_hint_check.source: Next makes one real call to the provider first, so a typo is refused here.

onboarding.model_hint_pick.text: 請選擇有金鑰的供應商。
onboarding.model_hint_pick.source: Pick a provider whose key is present.

onboarding.model_lede.text: 撰寫標題和摘要的模型。金鑰只存在 .env，不會存在這裡。
onboarding.model_lede.source: The model that writes headlines and summaries. Keys stay in .env, never here.

onboarding.no_key.text: 這裡沒有任何供應商的金鑰。請在 .env 設定 {$variables} 其中之一，再重新啟動：compose 安裝請執行 docker compose up -d --force-recreate，uv 安裝請重新執行 cyris triage-ui。或維持「不使用」。
onboarding.no_key.source: No provider has its key here. Set one of {$variables} in .env, then restart: under compose run docker compose up -d --force-recreate, under uv start cyris triage-ui again. Or keep None.

onboarding.no_reason.text: cyris 回應 {$status}，但未說明原因。請再試一次；如果持續失敗，請查看伺服器日誌。
onboarding.no_reason.source: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.

onboarding.no_reason_reload.text: cyris 回應 {$status}，但未說明原因。請重新載入頁面再試一次；如果持續失敗，請查看伺服器日誌。
onboarding.no_reason_reload.source: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Reload the page to try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.

onboarding.notify_lede.text: 每期精選完成後通知的管道。兩個都留空就不通知。
onboarding.notify_lede.source: Where a finished issue is announced. Leave both empty to be notified nowhere.

onboarding.opening_claim.text: 資訊太多、太快。我先幫你接住；什麼重要，由{#em}你{/em}決定。
onboarding.opening_claim.source: Too much, too fast. I’ll hold it for you; {#em}you{/em} say what matters.

onboarding.own_added.text: 「{$name}」已列在「你的資訊來源」並勾選，按「下一步」會和其他資訊來源一起新增。
onboarding.own_added.source: {$name} is under Your feeds, checked: Next adds it with the others.

onboarding.own_feed_help.text: 貼上資訊來源的網址，或有連結資訊來源的網站首頁。名稱會採用資訊來源本身的標題。
onboarding.own_feed_help.source: A feed's address, or a site's home page that links one. It is named by the feed's own title.

onboarding.own_listed.source: {$name} is already listed, and is checked there.

onboarding.page_description.text: 引導你設定新的 Cyris：語言、發布時間、來源、投票、通知、模型和第一期。
onboarding.page_description.source: The guided setup of a new Cyris deployment: language, publish hours, sources, votes, notifications, the model and the first issue.

onboarding.paste_first.text: 請先貼上資訊來源的網址或網站首頁。
onboarding.paste_first.source: Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page, first.

onboarding.pick_provider.text: 請選擇有金鑰的供應商，或選擇「不使用」。
onboarding.pick_provider.source: Pick a provider whose key is present, or None.

onboarding.picked.text: 已勾選 {$count} 個資訊來源。

onboarding.picked_slow.text: 「投票」步驟會先抓取每個勾選的資訊來源，再發出卡片：{$slow} 個以內約需一分鐘，超過會更久。
onboarding.picked_slow.source: The Votes step fetches every picked feed before it deals cards: up to {$slow} take about a minute, and more take longer.

onboarding.plan_no_sources.text: 尚未加入任何來源，無法產生精選。請按「上一步」挑選，或按「完成」，之後再到「設定」的「來源」新增。
onboarding.plan_no_sources.source: There are no sources yet, so there is nothing to build an issue from. Press Back to pick some, or Finish and add them later under Sources in Settings.

onboarding.plan_published.text: 最近一個發布時間的精選（{$date}）已發布，現在產生會取代它。請到過往精選閱讀。
onboarding.plan_published.source: The issue of the latest publish hour, dated {$date}, is already published, and one built now would replace it. Read it in the archive.

onboarding.plan_started.text: 已從這個頁面開始產生第一期。
onboarding.plan_started.source: The first issue was started from this page.

onboarding.plan_today.text: 需要幾分鐘；今天稍後的精選不會取代它。
onboarding.plan_today.source: It takes a few minutes, and no later issue today replaces it.

onboarding.plan_yesterday.text: 今天的發布時間 {$hours}（{$timezone}）都還沒到，屆時產生的精選會取代今天日期那一期；按「產生第一期」會立即開始，日期記為昨天，需要幾分鐘。
onboarding.plan_yesterday.source: Start builds the first issue now, dated yesterday: neither of today's publish hours, {$hours} {$timezone}, has begun, and an issue dated today would be replaced by them. It takes a few minutes.

onboarding.recorded_votes.text: 已記錄 {$count} 票：多看 {$up} 票，少看 {$down} 票。

onboarding.run_error.text: 發生錯誤，精選產生中止。
onboarding.run_error.source: The run stopped with an error.

onboarding.run_failed_next.text: 無論如何，下一個發布時間都會產生新的一期。請按「再試一次」，或按「完成」離開。
onboarding.run_failed_next.source: Press Try again, or Finish to leave: the next publish hour brings an issue either way.

onboarding.run_no_articles.text: 在本期讀取的時間範圍內，你的資訊來源都沒有文章。
onboarding.run_no_articles.source: None of your feeds had an article in the window the run reads.

onboarding.run_no_pending.text: 時間範圍內的文章都已評選過，本期沒有新內容。
onboarding.run_no_pending.source: Every article in the window was already decided, so the run had nothing new.

onboarding.run_publish_failed.text: 精選已產生，但發布到過往精選失敗。
onboarding.run_publish_failed.source: The issue was built, but publishing it to the archive failed.

onboarding.run_timed_out.text: {$minutes} 分鐘內沒有任何精選產生完成，本期可能未開始產生，或未留下執行紀錄就中止。請到 app Worker 的日誌查看。
onboarding.run_timed_out.source: No run has ended in {$minutes} minutes, so this one did not start or stopped without a record. Its log is in the app Worker's logs.

onboarding.saved_advanced.text: 進階：已儲存 {$count} 項設定。{$note}

onboarding.session_expired.text: 登入已過期。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
onboarding.session_expired.source: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.

onboarding.settings_load_failed.text: 無法載入設定：{$reason}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
onboarding.settings_load_failed.source: Could not load settings: {$reason}. Reload the page to try again.

onboarding.settings_not_loaded.text: 設定未載入。請重新載入頁面。
onboarding.settings_not_loaded.source: The settings did not load. Reload the page.

onboarding.sources_feeds_lede.text: 以下是所選主題的資訊來源。請勾選你會讀的；按「上一步」可以更改主題。
onboarding.sources_feeds_lede.source: The feeds of the topics you picked. Check the ones you read; Back changes the topics.

onboarding.sources_had.text: 本站已有來源。之後可以到「設定」的「來源」新增更多；按「下一步」繼續。
onboarding.sources_had.source: This deployment already has sources. Add more later under Sources in Settings; Next moves on.

onboarding.sources_topics_lede.text: 本站要讀取的資訊來源，每個都由發布者自己提供。
onboarding.sources_topics_lede.source: The feeds this deployment reads, each a publisher's own feed.

onboarding.timezone_detected.text: 從這個瀏覽器偵測到，尚未儲存；按「下一步」會儲存。
onboarding.timezone_detected.source: Detected from this browser, and not saved yet: Next saves it.

onboarding.topics_hint.text: 選擇主題，查看其資訊來源。若一個都不選就按「下一步」，會直接前往新增自己的資訊來源。
onboarding.topics_hint.source: Pick topics to see their feeds. Next with none picked goes straight to adding your own feed.

onboarding.unreachable.text: 無法連線到 cyris（{$reason}）。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
onboarding.unreachable.source: Could not reach cyris ({$reason}). Check the connection and try again.

onboarding.vote_similarity_off.text: 投票相似度仍未開啟，投票暫時沒有作用：{$reason} 請到「設定」的「模型」開啟。
onboarding.vote_similarity_off.source: Vote similarity is still off, so votes have no effect yet: {$reason} Turn it on under Model in Settings.

onboarding.votes_gone.text: 發卡片後已有 {$count} 篇文章離開資訊來源，這些票未記錄。

onboarding.votes_lede.text: 以下是資訊來源中幾篇較舊的文章：請標出會讀和不會讀的，其餘不用管。按「下一步」會把每個標記記為一票，第一期就不會收錄這些文章。
onboarding.votes_lede.source: A few older articles from your feeds: mark the ones you would read and the ones you would not, and leave the rest. Next records each mark as a vote, so the first issue leaves those articles out.

raw.description.text: Cyris {$issue} 精選評選過的所有文章，依來源分組。
raw.description.source: Every article the {$issue} issue of a Cyris digest judged, grouped by source.

raw.hint.text: 往左滑選少看，往右滑選多看；選取卡片後，也可以按 ← 或 →。點一下卡片，會在新分頁開啟文章。
raw.hint.source: Swipe left for down, right for up; with the card focused, ← and → do the same. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.

raw.intro.text: 本期評選過的所有文章，加上還待定的。精選只挑出其中一部分。
raw.intro.source: Everything the run decided on, plus what is still pending. The digest is a selection of these.

raw.label.text: 所有文章 · {$articles} 篇 · {$sources} 個來源

settings.access_not_set_up.text: 本站還沒設定 Access。請管理員完成 Cloudflare Access 設定後，重新載入頁面。
settings.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

settings.answered_without_reason.text: cyris 回應 {$status}，但未說明原因。請再試一次；如果持續失敗，請查看伺服器日誌。
settings.answered_without_reason.source: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.

settings.clef_needs_votes.text: Clef 需要先在「模型」開啟投票相似度。
settings.clef_needs_votes.source: Clef needs vote similarity on, under Model.

settings.digest_intro.text: 每期何時發布、包含什麼內容，以及文字顯示多大。
settings.digest_intro.source: When issues are published, what each one holds, and how large its text reads.

settings.cross_origin.text: 這次儲存被拒絕：它不是從這個設定頁送出的。請重新載入頁面後再儲存。
settings.cross_origin.source: This save was refused: it did not come from this settings page. Reload the page and save again.

settings.effort_hint.text: 越高越耗 token 與時間。「預設」沿用各供應商的等級，OpenAI 則用低；Workers AI 一律用低。按「儲存」時會呼叫一次來檢查等級。
settings.effort_hint.source: More costs more tokens and time. Default keeps each provider's own level, except low on OpenAI; Workers AI always runs at low, and Save checks the level with one call.

settings.hours_hint.text: 每期在你選的整點發布，時間依下方的時區。
settings.hours_hint.source: Each digest is published on the hour you choose, in the time zone below.

settings.load_settings_failed.text: 無法載入設定：{$error}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
settings.load_settings_failed.source: Could not load settings: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.

settings.load_sources_failed.text: 無法載入來源：{$error}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
settings.load_sources_failed.source: Could not load sources: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.

settings.load_topics_failed.text: 無法載入主題：{$error}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
settings.load_topics_failed.source: Could not load topics: {$error}. Reload the page to try again.

settings.missing_notice.text: 尚未設定：{$labels}。儲存之前，下一期不會產生。
settings.missing_notice.source: Not set yet: {$labels}. The next run stops until they are saved.

settings.model_hint_call.text: 儲存前會先實際呼叫供應商一次，名稱打錯會在這裡退回。
settings.model_hint_call.source: Saving makes one real call to the provider first, so a typo is rejected here.

settings.model_hint_pick.text: 請選擇有金鑰的供應商。
settings.model_hint_pick.source: Pick a provider whose key is present.

settings.model_intro.text: 下一期會呼叫的模型，以及如何運用你的投票。
settings.model_intro.source: The models the next run calls, and how it uses your votes.

settings.no_settings_store.text: 本站沒有設定儲存區，無法在這裡儲存設定。
settings.no_settings_store.source: This deployment has no settings store, so nothing can be saved here.

settings.no_source_table.text: 這裡沒有可寫入的來源表。

settings.no_sources.text: 還沒有來源。新增來源之前，下一期會先等待。
settings.no_sources.source: No sources yet. The next run waits until one is added.

settings.no_topic_table.text: 這裡沒有可寫入的主題表。

settings.notifications_intro.text: 每期完成後，要在哪裡通知。
settings.notifications_intro.source: Where a finished issue is announced.

settings.page_description.text: 本站的 Cyris 設定：模型、精選、處理流程、通知、來源與追蹤主題。
settings.page_description.source: Settings for this Cyris deployment: model, digest, pipeline, notifications, sources and tracked topics.

settings.pipeline_intro.text: 每期往回找多久、讀多少內容，以及在哪裡截斷。
settings.pipeline_intro.source: How far back each run looks, how much it reads, and where it cuts.

settings.sender_match_hint.text: 把寄件者對應到這個來源；郵件路由本身仍在 Cloudflare 主控台設定。
settings.sender_match_hint.source: Maps a sender to this source; email routing itself stays in the Cloudflare dashboard.

settings.session_expired.text: 登入已過期。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
settings.session_expired.source: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.

settings.sources_intro.text: 下一期會讀取的資訊來源與電子報寄件者。
settings.sources_intro.source: The feeds and newsletter senders the next run reads.

settings.timezone_detected.text: 從這個瀏覽器偵測到，尚未儲存。
settings.timezone_detected.source: Detected from this browser, and not saved yet.

settings.topic_description_hint.text: 用一句話說明這個主題在講什麼。
settings.topic_description_hint.source: One sentence saying what the topic is about.

settings.topic_other_model.text: 為 {$model} 設定；每期改以 {$current} 嵌入，略過此主題
settings.topic_other_model.source: Set for {$model}; runs embed with {$current}, so it is skipped

settings.topic_threshold_hint.text: 標題須達到的餘弦值，以該模型的尺度計算，沒有預設值。{#code}cyris topic-sim{/code} 會依說明為時間範圍內的標題排名，請選仍切題的最低餘弦值。
settings.topic_threshold_hint.source: The cosine a title must reach, on that model's scale; there is no default. {#code}cyris topic-sim{/code} ranks the window's titles against the description: pick the lowest cosine still on topic.

settings.tracking_intro.text: 每期會在「追蹤」下列出與這些主題相近的所有文章。
settings.tracking_intro.source: Topics each issue lists every close article for, under Tracking.

settings.unreachable.text: 無法連線到 cyris（{$error}）。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
settings.unreachable.source: Could not reach cyris ({$error}). Check the connection and try again.

settings.vote_similarity_hint.text: 排除與你投少看的文章相近的候選文章。可用 {#code}cyris vote-sim{/code} 預覽會排除哪些。
settings.vote_similarity_hint.source: Drop candidates close to an article you voted down. Preview what it would drop with {#code}cyris vote-sim{/code}.

settings.webhook_hint.text: 如要更改，請貼上完整網址，Discord 確認網址存在後才會儲存。按「關閉通知」會清除網址，之後每期完成時不再發送訊息。
settings.webhook_hint.source: To change it, paste the whole URL; it is saved once Discord confirms it exists. Turn off clears it: runs then finish without a message.

settings_api.mail_needs_cloudflare.text: 本站未設定 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID 或 CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN，無法寄信。請設定兩者後再儲存一次。
settings_api.mail_needs_cloudflare.source: This deployment has no CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID or CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN, so it cannot send mail. Set both, then save again.

settings_api.mail_needs_sender.text: 也請填寫寄出精選的地址。
settings_api.mail_needs_sender.source: Enter the address the digest is sent from, too.

settings_api.mail_saved.text: 已儲存。下一期精選會寄到這個地址。
settings_api.mail_saved.source: Saved. The next digest run mails this address.

settings_api.newsletter_needs_sender.text: 電子報來源需要寄件者比對。
settings_api.newsletter_needs_sender.source: A newsletter source needs a Sender match.

settings_api.no_source_table.text: 儲存後端不是「sqlite」或「d1」，沒有可寫入的來源表
settings_api.no_source_table.source: No writable source table (store backend is neither "sqlite" nor "d1")

settings_api.no_topic.text: 找不到名為 {$name} 的主題，請重新載入頁面。
settings_api.no_topic.source: No topic named {$name}: reload the page.

settings_api.no_topic_table.text: 儲存後端不是「sqlite」或「d1」，沒有可寫入的主題表
settings_api.no_topic_table.source: No writable topic table (store backend is neither "sqlite" nor "d1")

settings_api.own_form.source: {$label} is saved from its own form

settings_api.pages_within_a_minute.text: 一分鐘內會顯示在頁面上。
settings_api.pages_within_a_minute.source: Pages show it within a minute.

settings_api.rss_needs_url.text: RSS 來源需要資訊來源網址。
settings_api.rss_needs_url.source: An RSS source needs a Feed URL.

settings_api.saved_next_run.text: 已儲存。下一期精選會套用。
settings_api.saved_next_run.source: Saved. The next digest run picks this up.

settings_api.some_within_a_minute.text: {$labels}一分鐘內會顯示在頁面上，其餘設定下一期生效。
settings_api.some_within_a_minute.source: {$labels}: pages show it within a minute. The rest: effective next run.

settings_api.source_field_locked.text: 這份摘要的來源是以名稱、網址和分類設定的 RSS 訂閱；{$field} 不開放設定。
settings_api.source_field_locked.source: This digest's sources are RSS feeds set by name, URL and lane; {$field} is not yours to set.

settings_api.source_type_unknown.text: 來源類型只能是 rss 或 newsletter，不能是 {$type}。
settings_api.source_type_unknown.source: A source's type is rss or newsletter, not {$type}.

settings_api.test_mail_body.text: 這個地址會收到每一期精選。
settings_api.test_mail_body.source: This address will receive a message for every digest.

settings_api.test_mail_failed.source: The test message was not sent: {$error}

settings_api.topic_needs_description.text: 主題需要說明：用一句話說明它在講什麼。
settings_api.topic_needs_description.source: A topic needs a description: one sentence saying what it is about.

settings_api.topic_needs_model.text: 主題需要填寫設定門檻時所用的嵌入模型。
settings_api.topic_needs_model.source: A topic needs the embedding model its threshold was set for.

settings_api.topic_threshold_range.text: 門檻是大於 0、最多為 1 的餘弦值。
settings_api.topic_threshold_range.source: Threshold is a cosine above 0 and at most 1.

settings_api.values_empty.text: values 至少要包含一項設定
settings_api.values_empty.source: values must name at least one setting

settings_api.vote_not_checked.text: 投票相似度已關閉，未檢查嵌入模型。開啟時會先檢查。
settings_api.vote_not_checked.source: Not checked: vote similarity is off. Turning it on checks the embedder first.

settings_api.vote_operator_embedder.text: 這裡不檢查嵌入模型：它由服務的營運方提供。
settings_api.vote_operator_embedder.source: Not checked here: the service's operator provides the embedder.

settings_api.webhook_empty.text: 請貼上 Discord webhook 網址，或按「關閉通知」停止通知。
settings_api.webhook_empty.source: Paste a Discord webhook URL, or press Turn off to stop notifications.

settings_help.clef_needs_token.text: Clef 需要 Workers AI 權杖，請設定 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID 和 CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN（或 CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN）。
settings_help.clef_needs_token.source: Clef needs a Workers AI token: set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN (or CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN).

settings_help.digest.max_articles_per_di.text: 每期從所有來源中，依發布時間取時間範圍內最新的幾篇文章，評分後編入精選。
settings_help.digest.max_articles_per_di.source: How many of the window's newest articles, by publish time, one run scores and digests across all sources.

settings_help.digest.output_language.text: 標題和摘要使用的語言。
settings_help.digest.output_language.source: The language headlines and summaries are written in.

settings_help.digest.preference_source.text: 決定哪些項目排在前面：依你的主題投票，或由 Clef 參考與各項目最相近的投票。Clef 無法完整評分的那一期，會改用你的主題投票。
settings_help.digest.preference_source.source: Who decides which items come first: your topic votes, or Clef reading the votes nearest each item. An issue Clef cannot fully score uses your topic votes.

settings_help.digest.rank_by_preference.text: 把你投多看的主題，以及與它們同名的主題排在前面。排序只會調整順序，不會因此移除任何項目。
settings_help.digest.rank_by_preference.source: Put first the items on topics you voted up, and on topics that share a name with them. The order only moves items; nothing is left out for it.

settings_help.digest.style_prompt.text: 用自己的話描述摘要的語氣或重點；留空表示不指定。
settings_help.digest.style_prompt.source: Your tone or focus for the summaries, in your own words; empty means none.

settings_help.digest.summarize_follow.text: 為你關注的來源中每篇文章加上簡短說明，如同精讀文章。關閉時顯示文章本身的開頭。
settings_help.digest.summarize_follow.source: Give each article from a source you follow a short explanation of what it is, as read articles get. Off shows the start of its own text.

settings_help.digest.topic_lifetime_days.text: 在這個天數內出現過的主題算是現行主題，新文章可以加入；許多主題共用一個名稱時，這個名稱在排序中份量較低。投多看會讓主題較慢離開可加入清單；此效果隨投票半衰期減弱，最長不超過主題最後出現後此天數的三倍。
settings_help.digest.topic_lifetime_days.source: Topics seen within this many days are current: new articles can join them, and a name many of them share counts for less in the order. An upvote slows how fast a topic leaves the list new articles can join; the effect fades with the vote half-life, and never lasts past three times this many days after the topic last appeared.

settings_help.digest.type_scale.text: 一分鐘內套用到每個頁面，已發布的精選也適用。
settings_help.digest.type_scale.source: Applies to every page within a minute, issues already published too.

settings_help.digest.vote_half_life_days.text: 每一票經過這個天數後，權重只剩一半；除非再次投票，偏好會逐漸淡去。
settings_help.digest.vote_half_life_days.source: A vote counts half as much after this many days, so a preference fades unless you vote again.

settings_help.general.digest_window_hour.text: 每期往回找多久以內的文章。
settings_help.general.digest_window_hour.source: How far back a run looks for articles.

settings_help.general.timezone.source: The clock the publish hours are read in.

settings_help.notify.email_from.text: 請填寫 Email Routing 網域上的地址。
settings_help.notify.email_from.source: An address on your Email Routing domain.

settings_help.notify.email_to.text: 留空就不寄信。必須是 Cloudflare Email Routing 中已驗證的收件地址，測試信寄達後才會儲存。
settings_help.notify.email_to.source: Leave it empty to send no mail. It must be a verified destination in Cloudflare Email Routing, and is saved once a test message reaches it.

settings_help.notify.own_addresses.text: 從這些地址或收件地址寄給 cyris 的信，會當成轉寄來讀：歸到信中引用的原寄件者，不會歸到你名下。多個地址以逗號分隔。
settings_help.notify.own_addresses.source: Mail to cyris from these, or from Email to, is read as a forward: it is filed under the sender it quotes, never under you. Separate addresses with commas.

settings_help.routing.score_threshold.text: 同一主題有兩篇以上文章達到這個分數時，會一起列為頭條。
settings_help.routing.score_threshold.source: Two or more articles on one topic scoring at least this share the Top story.

settings_help.snippet_lengths.text: 讀得越多，每次呼叫的費用越高。

settings_help.vote_similarity.max_seeds.text: 每期比對時，多看和少看各取你最近的幾票。
settings_help.vote_similarity.max_seeds.source: How many of your most recent votes on each side a run compares against.

settings_help.vote_similarity.model.text: 開啟投票相似度時，會實際呼叫一次來檢查。
settings_help.vote_similarity.model.source: Checked with one real call when vote similarity is on.

settings_help.vote_similarity.provider.text: 投票相似度用這個嵌入模型比對文章。相似度門檻由模型決定，不在這裡設定。
settings_help.vote_similarity.provider.source: The embedder vote similarity compares articles with. Its similarity cutoff comes with the model, so it is not set here.

vote.access_not_set_up.text: 本站還沒設定 Access。請管理員完成 Cloudflare Access 設定後，重新載入頁面。
vote.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

vote.not_configured.text: 目前無法投票：app Worker 未設定 CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL。設定後請再投一次。
vote.not_configured.source: Voting is not set up here: the app Worker has no CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL. Set it, then vote again.

vote.refused.text: 投票失敗（HTTP {$status}），請再試一次。如果持續失敗，請檢查 promote Worker。
vote.refused.source: The vote did not go through (HTTP {$status}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the promote Worker.

vote.signed_out.text: 登入已過期，這次投票沒有記錄。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
vote.signed_out.source: Your session has ended, so the vote was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.

vote.unanswered.text: 伺服器沒有回應，投票可能沒有記錄。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
vote.unanswered.source: No answer from the server, so the vote may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.
